explorer.title: The Master Builder
explorer.tagline: You figure out how complex gadgets, games, and machines work from the inside out!
funQuests: Build a custom game level in Roblox or Scratch
Assemble a DIY robotics or electronics kit
explorer.parentTip: Nurture their curiosity with open-ended building tools, coding platforms, and mechanical toys rather than rigid instructions.

navigator.title: The Systems Architect
navigator.tagline: Deconstructs complex problems, spots hidden patterns, and engineers scalable systems.
navigator.flowTriggers: Tackling unstructured, challenging technical or algorithmic problems with high autonomy.
navigator.frictionTriggers: Repetitive bureaucratic tasks with rigid manual rules and zero optimization freedom.
navigator.streamFit: PCM with Computer Science / Applied Math

explorer.title: The Imagitative Designer
explorer.tagline: You blend wild creativity with deep curiosity to create things nobody else has thought of!
funQuests: Draw a comic book series or world map
Experiment with digital animation & 3D design
explorer.parentTip: Give them quiet time to create. Value their unique perspectives and encourage visual expression.

navigator.title: The Creative Visionary
navigator.tagline: Fuses high-level aesthetic intuition with deep conceptual depth to design the future.
navigator.flowTriggers: Designing brand new concepts, visual media, or immersive user experiences from scratch.
navigator.frictionTriggers: Strictly regimented, number-heavy environments where creative risk is discouraged.
navigator.streamFit: Design / Applied Arts / Humanities with Digital Media

explorer.title: The Business Mind
explorer.tagline: You spot great ideas quickly and love turning fun plans into big team wins!
funQuests: Set up a fun game stall at school fest
Run a mini squad challenge with prize pools
explorer.parentTip: Support their entrepreneurial spark! Help them set up small projects where they manage a budget.

navigator.title: The Growth Strategist
navigator.tagline: Identifies market leverage, decodes data trends, and scales ideas into high-impact ventures.
navigator.flowTriggers: Analyzing competitive markets, setting growth strategy, and pitching high-stakes ideas.
navigator.frictionTriggers: Maintenance jobs where metrics are stagnant and there is no room for initiative.
navigator.streamFit: Commerce / Economics with Mathematics or Computer Applications

explorer.title: The Hardware Wizard
explorer.tagline: You love hands-on experiments, modding gear, and figuring out what makes tech tick!
funQuests: Mod a gaming controller or custom PC case
Build a mini drone or RC car from scratch
explorer.parentTip: Provide safe environments for physical tinkering, dismantling old electronics, and hands-on science.

navigator.title: The Tech Alchemist
navigator.tagline: Bridges physical mechanics and software logic to craft cutting-edge physical technology.
navigator.flowTriggers: Working directly with physical prototypes, IoT devices, robotics, or custom hardware.
navigator.frictionTriggers: Purely theoretical debate without tangible testing or real-world execution.
navigator.streamFit: PCM with Physics & Electronics / Vocational Tech

explorer.title: The Heart & Voice
explorer.tagline: You express feelings amazingly well and always make people feel connected and understood!
funQuests: Write podcast scripts or short stories
Host school events or drama performances
explorer.parentTip: Encourage their writing, public speaking, and creative performance. Validate their high emotional intelligence.

navigator.title: The Empathetic Storyteller
navigator.tagline: Master communicator who crafts resonant narratives that inspire communities and spark movement.
navigator.flowTriggers: Crafting compelling campaigns, interviewing inspiring people, or writing high-impact content.
navigator.frictionTriggers: Isolated, sterile environments focused purely on cold data with zero human touch.

explorer.title: The Master Organizer
explorer.tagline: You keep everything running smoothly, on schedule, and neatly organized!
funQuests: Create a master gaming schedule for friends
Organize family trip itineraries
explorer.parentTip: Appreciate their structure and organization! Let them take charge of planning family schedules.

navigator.title: The Ops Maestro
navigator.tagline: The execution engine that transforms chaos into clockwork operational efficiency.
navigator.flowTriggers: Structuring messy workflows, setting up automation systems, and managing timelines.
navigator.frictionTriggers: Vague, unorganized projects with constantly shifting goalposts and zero guidelines.

explorer.title: The Number Ninja
explorer.tagline: You see patterns in numbers that others miss and love cracking math puzzles!
funQuests: Solve Sudoku & math olympiad teasers
Analyze stats of your favorite sports team
explorer.parentTip: Feed their passion for math games, statistics, and logic puzzles. Support advanced math learning.

navigator.title: The Quantitative Pioneer
navigator.tagline: Unlocks hidden truths buried inside complex datasets, financial models, and mathematical structures.
navigator.flowTriggers: Analyzing complex data sets, building financial algorithms, or proving mathematical models.
navigator.frictionTriggers: Subjective arguments lacking empirical evidence or verifiable data.
navigator.streamFit: PCM / Economics with Statistics & Advanced Mathematics

explorer.title: The Captain
explorer.tagline: You naturally lead the squad, inspire confidence, and bring out the best in everyone!
funQuests: Run for school captain or club head
Organize a charity drive or sports tourney
explorer.parentTip: Guide their natural leadership skills with lessons in empathy, teamwork, and responsible influence.

navigator.title: The Human-Centric Leader
navigator.tagline: Rallies diverse teams around a shared vision, steering collective momentum toward ambitious goals.
navigator.flowTriggers: Leading mission-driven teams, managing stakeholders, and driving strategic direction.
navigator.frictionTriggers: Isolated back-office work with zero interpersonal interaction or team influence.
navigator.streamFit: Humanities / Commerce / Business Studies with Public Speaking

explorer.title: The Digital Creator
explorer.tagline: You love making things look cool, editing videos, designing graphics, and building visuals!
funQuests: Edit a viral-style video clip
Design custom stickers or digital art
explorer.parentTip: Support their interest in digital creative tools (Canva, Blender, Premiere, Figma).

navigator.title: The Digital Craftsman
navigator.tagline: Crafts pixel-perfect digital artifacts, blending technical craft with aesthetic finesse.
navigator.flowTriggers: Building high-fidelity UI components, 3D modeling, or editing cinematic media.
navigator.frictionTriggers: Purely verbal/administrative meetings with no opportunity to create artifacts.
navigator.streamFit: Arts / Applied Arts / Computer Graphics & Web Design

explorer.title: The Sleuth
explorer.tagline: Nothing gets past you! You love hunting for clues, finding mistakes, and solving mysteries.
funQuests: Solve mystery escape rooms or riddle threads
Find hidden easter eggs in software/games
explorer.parentTip: Challenge them with mystery books, logic puzzles, and forensic-style problem solving.

navigator.title: The Data Detective
navigator.tagline: Hunts down anomalies, uncovers root vulnerabilities, and verifies truth in complex systems.
navigator.flowTriggers: Debugging complex codebase errors, investigating cybersecurity breaches, or auditing data.
navigator.frictionTriggers: Superficial overviews that skip deep inspection and ignore edge cases.
navigator.streamFit: PCM with Computer Science / Cyber Security

explorer.title: The Squad Anchor
explorer.tagline: You make sure everyone feels safe, included, and cared for in any group setting!
funQuests: Start a welcome buddy system at school
Organize peer study groups
explorer.parentTip: Celebrate their reliability, kindness, and skill in keeping friendships strong and harmonious.

navigator.title: The Community Builder
navigator.tagline: Creates safe, structured, and thriving ecosystems where people collaborate and grow.
navigator.flowTriggers: Managing developer communities, organizing events, and building support infrastructure.
navigator.frictionTriggers: Aggressive sales environments that prioritize short-term profit over people.

explorer.title: The Idea Catalyst
explorer.tagline: You come up with creative concepts that look amazing AND actually work in real life!
funQuests: Pitch a new app idea to your family
Design a futuristic vehicle concept
explorer.parentTip: Encourage them to balance creative ideation with simple logical feasibility tests.

navigator.title: The Product Strategist
navigator.tagline: Combines user empathy, aesthetic flair, and business logic to build irresistible products.
navigator.flowTriggers: Defining product roadmaps, user research synthesis, and rapid prototype testing.
navigator.frictionTriggers: Legacy environments unwilling to innovate or pivot based on user feedback.
navigator.streamFit: Interdisciplinary: Science or Commerce with Design / IT

explorer.title: The Master Mechanic
explorer.tagline: You love precision tools, clean assemblies, and making machines run flawlessly!
funQuests: Build complex LEGO Technic sets
Help fix household appliances safely
explorer.parentTip: Provide structural building challenges, woodwork/robotics workshops, and precision crafts.

navigator.title: The Mechanical Innovator
navigator.tagline: Engineers physical products with high structural integrity and tight tolerances.
navigator.flowTriggers: CAD design, 3D printing, mechanical stress testing, and hardware fabrication.
navigator.frictionTriggers: Purely abstract philosophical debates without physical applicability.
navigator.streamFit: PCM with Mechanical / Automobile / Civil Engineering

explorer.title: The Curiosity Champ
explorer.tagline: You ask big questions about life, nature, and science, and love sharing answers with friends!
funQuests: Create a mini biology/space blog
Conduct fun home chemistry experiments
explorer.parentTip: Feed their passion for nature, science museums, space, and medical breakthroughs.

navigator.title: The Scientific Explorer
navigator.tagline: Dedicated to discovering scientific breakthroughs that improve human health and sustainability.
navigator.flowTriggers: Laboratory research, clinical data analysis, and environmental science studies.
navigator.frictionTriggers: Jobs that prioritize speed over accuracy and scientific truth.

explorer.title: The Action Leader
explorer.tagline: You get things done fast in the real world and love building practical things that earn!
funQuests: Organize a local recycling or yard sale drive
Build a simple service project
explorer.parentTip: Encourage practical projects that combine real-world physical action with financial planning.

navigator.title: The Venture Catalyst
navigator.tagline: Executes high-velocity projects in the real world, turning physical assets into value.
navigator.flowTriggers: Launching real-world operations, real estate tech, supply chain setups, or hardware ventures.
navigator.frictionTriggers: Endless passive discussions with no bias toward physical action.

explorer.title: The Story Creator
explorer.tagline: You bring stories, plays, and ideas to life with amazing enthusiasm and charm!
funQuests: Direct a short skit with friends
Write catchy lyrics or poetry
explorer.parentTip: Celebrate their expressive energy in drama, debate, creative writing, and social performance.

navigator.title: The Expressive Communicator
navigator.tagline: Captivates audiences through powerful verbal storytelling, performing arts, and social influence.
navigator.flowTriggers: Public speaking, content hosting, theatrical production, and brand storytelling.
navigator.frictionTriggers: Dry numeric data entry with no room for personal expression or storytelling.
navigator.streamFit: Arts & Humanities / Performing Arts / Mass Media
